Guidance & outlook: Corporate Profile FY26 at a Glance • $1.87 billion revenue • 29.2% year-over-year growth (in USD terms) • 14.4% EBIT margin • 21 large deals signed during FY26 • 95.5% repeat business • 35,777 professionals worldwide 04 AI-First Engineering | Architecting the Agentic Enterprise We have a robust set of AI assets and industry-domain focused AI solutions.

Coforge is built for this shift, combining AI, engineering depth, and domain expertise to deliver measurable business value at speed. the highest-ever number of large deal wins in our history, and our next-twelve-months signed order book stood at USD 1.75 billion, up 16.4% over FY25, giving us strong visibility into continued momentum in FY27.

The remuneration for FY25 & FY26 are considered for % Increase • The increase in the salary of other employees of the Company in FY26 was 5.3% (India: 5.6% and other locations: 4.2%). • The remuneration paid during the year FY26 was in line with the Remuneration Policy of the company.
Growth & demand: We delivered revenue growth of 29.2% over FY25 in USD terms, our second consecutive year of industry-leading growth, and our ninth consecutive year of robust, profitable growth overall.

The Company maintained its growth trajectory on the back of a robust order pipeline and a high-quality executable order book of USD 1.75 billion for the next twelve months as of Q4 FY26, reflecting a 16.4% year-over-year (YOY) increase.

Banking and Financial Services vertical grew by 18.0%, Insurance vertical grew 10.1%, Govt. outside India vertical grew 23.2% and the other emerging verticals, including manufacturing and retail, grew 34.2% For the full year FY26, the Company's gross margin was 33.8%.
Margins & costs: EBITDA margin expanded by 431 basis points year-on-year to 18.6%.
EBITDA margin for the quarter stood at 20.6%, while EBIT margin stood at 16.6%, representing the highest ever quarterly EBIT margin reported by the Company.
EBITDA stood at INR 30,464 million, translating into a margin of 18.6% for the year.

Balance sheet & cash: The year also reflected strong operating leverage, with EBIT margin expanding by 370 basis points YoY to 14.4%, while profit after tax increased to USD 177.4 million.
EBIT margin expanded by 370 basis points year-on-year to 14.4%, reflecting improved operating leverage, disciplined execution and the benefits of scale.

Return of surplus funds to Shareholders (Dividend) During FY26, we continuously followed the practice of returning of surplus cash available with the Company to the shareholders and based on the Company's performance, the Company has paid interim dividends aggregating to INR 15.8 per equity share of face value INR 2 each involving a cash outflow of INR 5,291…
Risks & challenges: While inflationary pressures are gradually easing and financial conditions remain broadly supportive, business sentiment continues to be influenced by elevated policy uncertainty and the risk of renewed trade disruptions.
Inflation declined from 5.8% in 2024 to 4.1% in 2025 and is expected to remain contained at around 4.4% in 2026, before easing further to 3.7% by 2027.
